Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.Language.Title: Language
Settings.Language.Label: Interface language
Settings.Language.Caption: Menus, the overlay and card names. System follows your Hearthstone client or computer, else English.
Settings.Language.RestartHint: Card names switch to the new language after you restart Hearthpulse.
Settings.Theme.TintTip: Left is grey, right is strongly colored
Settings.Theme.PageHeroesTip: A hero behind each page: your last game's, your best Battlegrounds hero, your most played class. The art loads from HearthstoneJSON once and stays on disk.
Settings.App.Title: App
Settings.App.Tray: Keep running in the tray when closed
Settings.App.ReduceMotionTip: Pages and panels appear without sliding, switches and tabs change at once. Windows’ own animation setting is followed either way.
Settings.App.AutoUpdateTip: Hearthpulse checks GitHub for a newer version and installs it when you close the app
Settings.Shortcuts.Title: Keyboard shortcuts
Settings.Shortcuts.Pages: Open a page, Home to Settings
Settings.Shortcuts.Back: Leave a deck or match page
Settings.Shortcuts.Hide: Hide or show the overlay for a while (the Overlay switch stays as it is)
Settings.Shortcuts.Layout: Arrange overlay panels; again to finish
Settings.Shortcuts.Refresh: Hard refresh: re-read the current game
Settings.Overlay.Title: In-game overlay
Settings.Overlay.EnabledTip: Master switch for everything drawn over Hearthstone. Ctrl+Shift+H hides the overlay for a while and leaves this switch as it is.
Settings.Overlay.OffNote: The overlay is off: these panels will not appear in game until you turn it on.
Settings.Overlay.TrackerLink: Deck, opponent, card pool, counter and mulligan panels are on the Tracker tab.
Settings.Overlay.EnabledTipWindows: Master switch for everything drawn over Hearthstone. On Windows, Ctrl+Shift+H hides the overlay for a while and leaves this switch as it is.
Settings.Overlay.TopBarTip: Turn, tavern tiers, lobby tribes and rating. Click a tier number in game to see that tier's minions in your lobby.
Settings.Overlay.PickHintsHighlightCapti: Badges mark the best hero, trinket, buy and Discover option.
Settings.Overlay.PickHintsStatsOnlyCapti: The same stats on every option, with nothing marked as the best.
Settings.Overlay.BoardsTip: When you hover the leaderboard: the last board you saw for that player in combat.
Settings.Overlay.LobbyTip: Health, tier and last fight of every player in the lobby.
Settings.Overlay.BgLobbyTip: A compact panel: the lobby's tribes, every player's tavern tier and the main tribe of their board you last saw in a fight.
Settings.Overlay.BgBadgesTip: Beside each opponent on the leaderboard: their tavern tier and, after a fight with them, their board's main tribe and its minion count.
Settings.Overlay.OddsTip: Win, tie and loss from thousands of simulated fights of both boards, shown while the fight plays.
Settings.Overlay.SessionTip: Rating and placements of this session.
Settings.Overlay.OpacityTip: How solid the panels' backgrounds are. Text, numbers and icons always stay fully visible.
Settings.Overlay.DensityTip: Panel size and short card rows in one choice. Each panel can still be adjusted on its own afterwards.
Settings.Overlay.Preview: How the overlay looks in a game
Settings.Layout.Title: Panel layout
Settings.Layout.Caption: Drag every overlay panel where you want it in game. Scroll over a panel to resize it, right-click to reset it. Shortcut: Ctrl+Shift+L.
Settings.Layout.CaptionWindows: Drag every overlay panel where you want it in game. Scroll over a panel to resize it, right-click to reset it. Shortcut on Windows: Ctrl+Shift+L.
Settings.Layout.Unlocked: Unlock panels: move them with the mouse in game
Settings.Layout.UnlockedCaption: Unlocked panels move with the mouse, no Ctrl. Rows over the game's cards move only with Ctrl.
Settings.Leaderboard.Title: Leaderboard hover
Settings.Leaderboard.Caption: Fallback boxes: line them up with the leaderboard if a hover shows the wrong board.
Settings.Leaderboard.CaptionCrossPlatfor: Line the boxes up with the leaderboard if a hover shows the wrong board.
Settings.Tracker.Title: Deck tracker
Settings.Tracker.OpponentTip: Cards the opponent played and how long cards stayed in their hand.
Settings.Tracker.CardPoolTip: What a Discover or random card can give: during a Discover, right after you play such a card, and while you hover it in hand. Right-click the panel for the full list.
Settings.Tracker.OverlayLink: The overlay switch, its size and the panel layout are on the Overlay tab.
Settings.Counters.Title: Counters and mulligan
Settings.Counters.Caption: Auto shows a counter when a card in your deck, or one your opponent revealed, needs it. Click a counter in game for details.
Settings.Counters.MulliganTip: Keep rate and win rate with the card in hand, for the archetype your deck matches
Settings.Counters.BgCaption: Auto shows a counter when a card that needs it is in the tavern, your hand, board, trinkets or hero power.
Settings.Account.Title: Hearthpulse account
Settings.Account.SignedOutCaption: Opens hearthpulse.net in your browser. The tracker works the same without an account.
Settings.Data.Title: Your data
Settings.Data.PoolSharing: Share my games with the stats pool
Settings.Data.PoolSharingTip: After each Battlegrounds game: the heroes you were offered and the one you picked, your placement, solo or duos, your rating rounded to 500, the lobby's tribes and anomaly, your final board, your trinkets, the turns you leveled up, each fight's result, damage and predicted odds, every pick you make (Discover, triple rewards, trinkets, quests and their rewards) and the cards you play. Your Battlegrounds games from the last 30 days are sent once too. After each Ranked or Casual game: the cards each Discover, Adapt or Choose One card offered you, the one you took, the format and whether you won. Never your name, BattleTag, account, deck or anything about other players. The totals are public; shared games are kept for 60 days, then deleted.
Settings.Data.ImportTip: Reads the Hearthstone logs still on disk and adds games that are missing from History
Settings.Sources.Text: Data: stats from Hearthpulse data (api.kolodahearthstone.com; the Battlegrounds tab lists from bg.hs-manacost.ru), cards and art from HearthstoneJSON.
Settings.About.Title: About
Settings.About.Text: Hearthpulse reads Hearthstone's own log files and a few read-only values from game memory (your rating, rank and the lobby's tribes). It never shows hidden information such as your opponent's hand or deck.
Settings.About.TextCrossPlatform: Hearthpulse reads Hearthstone's own log files and, on Windows, a few read-only values from game memory (your rating, rank and the lobby's tribes). It never shows hidden information such as your opponent's hand or deck.
Settings.About.Fonts: Fonts: Montserrat (SIL Open Font License) · Material Design Icons (Pictogrammers, Apache 2.0).
Settings.About.FontsCrossPlatform: Fonts: Montserrat (SIL Open Font License) · Inter (SIL Open Font License) · Material Design Icons (Pictogrammers, Apache 2.0).
Settings.About.Icons: Navigation icons: game-icons.net by Lorc and Delapouite (CC BY 3.0), drawn in gold.
Settings.About.CheckNowTip: Ask GitHub whether a new version is out. Works with automatic updates off too.
Settings.Data.GameStats: Send my games to Hearthpulse statistics
Settings.Data.GameStatsTip: Cleaned match and draft journals: visible offers, choices, cards played and received, buys and sells, tavern refreshes, resources, shown board states and the result. Opponent cards only once shown in the game. Incomplete observations are marked; the server can reprocess saved journals to refine statistics.
Settings.Data.GameStatsNote: On by default; detailed journals start after the updated notice. No name, BattleTag, account, deck name, exact rating or hidden cards of other players. Kept on the Hearthpulse server for up to 180 days, separately from your site account; totals may support paid features. Turning sending off clears the queue and requests deletion; the status below shows when confirmation is still pending.
Settings.Data.CrashReportsNote: Sent: the app and system versions, the language, the error type and text and where in the code it happened. Names, BattleTags, e-mails, paths, quoted values and long numbers are cut out of the text; your account, history and game logs are never sent. Off: a report goes only when you press “Send report” in the error window; turning it off deletes reports waiting to go.
Settings.Search.Name: Search settings
Settings.Search.None: Nothing found. Try another word, such as “size” or “theme”.
Settings.Gallery.Title: Theme
Settings.Gallery.Hint: Hover a theme to preview it, click to use it.
Settings.Accent.Title: Accent colour
Settings.Background.Title: Page background
Settings.Background.AutoTip: The last game's hero, your best Battlegrounds hero, your most played class; Settings shows the theme's hero
Settings.Shape.Title: Interface
Settings.Shape.ScaleTip: Text and controls of the main window; the overlay has its own size on the Overlay tab
Settings.Reset.Ask: Restore every setting to its default? Your game history, account and panel positions stay.
Settings.File.Title: Settings file
Settings.File.Caption: Move your settings to another PC or keep a copy. The pool key, consents, account and folder paths are left out.
Settings.File.ExportFailed: The file could not be saved
Settings.File.NotSettings: This is not a Hearthpulse settings file
Settings.Data.SourceDeleting: Deletion of previously sent journals is awaiting server confirmation.
Settings.Data.SourceNotice: Journal sending starts after the updated notice.
Settings.Data.SourceDropped: Some journals could not be saved: {0}. These records are not treated as complete.
Settings.Data.SourceUnavailable: Journal sending is unavailable. Saved data remains queued.
